title: Page: from 20 s, about a third of user requests fail. Latency does not change.
explain: The second of the 3 API Server instances (#1) returns an error for 90% of its requests; the other 2 are fine. By default the load balancer only checks whether an instance is alive (it is), so it still sends it a third of the requests. Open the API Server's metrics: every instance is about as busy as the others, but failures go up. The problem is one instance, not the total capacity.
hint: Turn on outlier detection on the load balancer (it takes an instance that keeps failing out of rotation).
